FIELDS.NAME: Harmony Music Instruments & Repair
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Melody Lane, Suite 100, Harmony City, CA 90210-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Harmony Music Instruments & Repair, we specialize in the retail sale and expert repair of a wide variety of musical instruments, including string, percussion, brass, and woodwind instruments. Our core operations involve offering personalized customer service to assist musicians in selecting the right instruments and accessories to meet their needs. We also pride ourselves on our skilled repair technicians, who have extensive experience and qualifications in instrument repair. Our workshop is equipped to handle a range of repairs, from minor adjustments to major restorations, ensuring that every instrument performs at its best. We maintain a secure environment for high-value instruments with locked display cases and appropriate insurance coverage to protect against potential liabilities associated with the sale of instruments and accessories. Our commitment to quality is reflected in our processes for customer dispute resolution and regular staff training on safety and operational protocols. We focus on building lasting relationships with our customers by providing workshops and community engagement events that foster a love for music.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 10, 2022, a water leak in the workshop area caused damage to various instruments that were awaiting repairs. The estimated cost of repairs and replacements amounted to $2,000. The incident has been resolved, and all affected instruments have been repaired or replaced.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.ADDRESS: 456 Harmony Avenue, Suite 200, Harmony City, CA 90210-1234
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Saturday: 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM, Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Secure display cases for high-value instruments; located in a monitored retail environment with a central station alarm system; no vault used.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Additional security personnel on-site during busy weekends or events.
